text:
#DVCON submission skills - fully automated of writing the paper, create the pdf file, register the extended abstract and upload the paper for you.   No human touch is required.

https://lnkd.in/gSGSD7wH

author.name: Paul Marriott
author.headline: Senior Principal Verification Engineer at NXP

comments.text: I can tell you that all abstracts/papers that were written by AI will be rejected by the TPC.

author.name: Dave Rich
author.headline: Distinguished Technical Advisor at Arteris IP DVCon Technical and Steering Committee SystemVerilog IEEE Technical Chair

replies.text: Paul, Actually, it appears this skill doesn't write the content of the paper, just automates the process.

author.name: Paul Marriott
author.headline: Senior Principal Verification Engineer at NXP

replies.text: Dave Rich ok - thanks for the clarification as it read like it automates everything! Having AI check that all of the submission rules and formatting guidelines are respected would be a useful skill, though!
